title: Verticality+
description: Tired of having to open and close your inventory just to get items out? This mod adds vertical hotbar scrolling, so you can easily get stuff in and out of your inventory.
body:
# Verticality+

Are you **Tired** of sorting your hotbar by opening and closing your inventory each time? Well Verticality+ fixes this problem. You can use a key (Default: Left Alt) to scroll through your hotbar slot. For example, Line 1 of your inventory contains 4 items, you can easily scroll through it by pressing your set key by scrolling up and down.

### Key Features

* **Vertical Scrolling**: Navigate your inventory with a scrolling mechanic, making sorting your hotbar way easier.
* **Smart Fallback**: Makes it so that if there is nothing in your inventory slot above, it instantly goes to the slot with an item, making your experience easier and funner.
* **Customizable**: Easily toggle features and bind your preferred keys via **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config API**.

### Why use Verticality+?

**Because**, it makes minecraft easier, and just funner to play with. Personally, I even use Verticality in my minecraft game.

### Installation

1. Make sure you have **Fabric Loader** installed.
2. Drop the **Verticality+** JAR file into your `mods` folder.
3. Launch your game and enjoy a more efficient inventory experience!

*Note: This mod is a client-side utility and does not support installation on a server.*
